newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia launches push for tax system overhaul.
newsitem.headline: Australia launches push for tax system overhaul.

text.p: Australia's conservative government was due on Monday to launch a campaign to overhaul the country's complex and outdated tax system at a special meeting between coalition leaders and backbenchers.
Prime Minister John Howard said revamping the tax system was the most important economic reform facing his 16-month-old Liberal-National government.
"I can't think of an economic reform which is more fundamental, more comprehensive and more important in an enduring sense than taxation reform," he said in a radio interview.
